description: This file contains a series of shell script tests designed to verify the behavior of git merge operations and their corresponding commit messages. It defines test cases for various merge scenarios including local branch merge, octopus merge, tag merge, ambiguous tag, and remote-tracking branch merge.

methods.name: check_oneline
methods.description: Validates that the latest git log message matches an expected pattern.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution and validation of a code block.
